tips.text: Use Hymn of Valor when it will hit an enemy champion; each champion it damages gives a permanent stack that shortens your ability cooldowns.
Cast Aria of Perseverance when an ally is hurt; it heals you both and the shield protects the team. Casting it on a hurt ally also builds your stacks.
Stay close to your ally when you cast an ability, because the aura only helps allied champions near you. Your next attack also gets stronger.
Weave basic abilities between attacks. Every third basic ability makes your next attack stronger, with an effect that depends on the last ability you used.
End your Power Chord combo with Song of Celerity to get a slow on an enemy trying to escape or to close in on you.
Finish a Power Chord combo with Aria of Perseverance on a hard-hitting enemy; it cuts the damage they deal for a short time.
Aim Crescendo so it catches several enemies in a line. It stuns them all, so save it for a fight that decides the game.
Use Song of Celerity to run in or away with your team. The speed lasts longer if you don't take damage.
Stay far from Alistar. Headbutt has long range, so keep your distance and don't stand in front of him.
Poke with Hymn of Valor while Alistar is on cooldown. Back off when Headbutt and Pulverize are ready.
Use Song of Celerity to move out of reach when he starts to close in.
Alistar is tough, so do not spend Crescendo on him alone. Save it for a fight where it catches several enemies.
If he uses Unbreakable Will, Crescendo won't stun him through it. Wait until it ends before you cast.
Stay out of a straight line with Anivia so Flash Frost misses. Its stun will wreck your lane.
Land Hymn of Valor on Anivia when she steps up to cast; it hits champions first and builds your Accelerando.
Use Aria of Perseverance when Frostbite or Flash Frost is coming; the shield and heal soak her poke.
Save Crescendo for when Anivia is committed to Glacial Storm or caught out; her egg means you may need to kill her twice.
Cast Hymn of Valor whenever the enemy walks into range; it hits the nearest two enemies and builds your Accelerando, so poke often.
Stay out of a straight line with your lane partner and the enemy minions. Cosmic Binding stuns when it hits a second target or a wall.
Don't stand next to a wall when Bard is lined up. Cosmic Binding stuns the first target if it hits terrain behind them.
Crescendo can stun Bard and his partner together when they stand close. Save it for when they commit to a fight.
Walk over Bard's Caretaker's Shrine to destroy it before his ally takes the heal.
Hold Song of Celerity for escaping or chasing. Its speed boost lasts longer if you aren't hit.
Stay behind minions when Blitzcrank is near; Rocket Grab stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way takes the hook instead of you.
Hit Blitzcrank with Hymn of Valor when he walks up to the minions. It has long range and also builds your Accelerando.
Once Rocket Grab is on cooldown, step forward and trade, because he has no other way to reach you from range.
Save Song of Celerity for escaping after a grab, or for repositioning once his hook is down.
Use Crescendo on Blitzcrank and his partner when they commit. It stuns everyone it hits.
Stay spread out from your carry. Brand's Conflagration and Pyroclasm hit whoever is clustered together, so don't stand on top of your ADC.
Cast Hymn of Valor on Brand when he steps up. It hits the two nearest enemies, so it can poke him and the minion beside him.
Sear stops at the first enemy it hits. Stay behind a minion in lane so it hits the minion instead of you.
If Brand has set you ablaze, expect Sear to stun you. Keep moving, and don't stand still where Pillar of Flame will land.
Use Aria of Perseverance to heal off Brand's burn damage. Its shield also absorbs some of his damage.
Save Crescendo for when Brand is close and has used Sear. Stunning him leaves him open to your whole team.
Stay out of Winter's Bite range; it travels in a line and stops at the first unit it hits, so keep a minion between you and Braum.
Stay away from Braum's allies' attacks once he marks you; four hits means a stun, so back off after the first stack.
Aim Hymn of Valor when Braum's shield is not facing you; it hits the two nearest enemies and favors champions.
Wait for Unbreakable to run out before you try to hit him with Hymn of Valor.
Cast Crescendo from range to stun Braum and his partner together, but wait until Unbreakable is down.
Use Aria of Perseverance to heal and shield your carry after trades.
Use Song of Celerity to move out of Glacial Fissure's path; its cast time is long enough to dodge.
Poke Camille with Hymn of Valor from range, then step back before she can dive onto you.
Hold Crescendo for when Camille dives in with Hookshot; stunning her mid-fight turns the fight your way.
Camille's Tactical Sweep slows you when the outer edge hits. Stay out of its reach, and use Song of Celerity to get away.
Use Aria of Perseverance to heal and shield your carry when Camille trades, since she can hit them hard in a short fight.
Camille's ultimate locks one target in a zone. Stay close to your ally so you can stun her with Crescendo.
Stay out of Zephyr range when you can; Janna's slow and poke hurt a lot when you stand still in lane.
Hold Crescendo until Janna has used Monsoon or her Howling Gale, then stun the team while their escape is down.
Use Hymn of Valor when Janna steps up to the minions; it hits the nearest two enemies and favors champions.
Use Aria of Perseverance to heal back damage after a trade. Its shield helps your carry in a fight.
Janna's Howling Gale knocks you up. Use Song of Celerity to move out of its path once you hear it charging.
Stay out of Inner Flame's path; it stops at the first unit it hits, so keep a minion between you and Karma when you can.
Move away when Karma tethers you with Focused Resolve. Getting far enough away breaks it and you avoid the root.
Use Hymn of Valor to poke Karma when she steps up; it hits the two nearest enemies and fuels your Accelerando.
Hold Crescendo until Karma and her partner are bunched together, so the stun catches both of them.
Take cover from a bigger Soulflare circle by leaving the fire right away, then heal back up with Aria of Perseverance.
Stay out of Zenith Blade range. If Leona lands it, she dashes onto you and roots you, and then she stuns you with Shield of Daybreak.
Poke with Hymn of Valor while Leona waits for her cooldowns. Be careful, because it only hits the nearest two enemies.
Hold Aria of Perseverance until Leona commits. Cast it as she dashes in, so its shield soaks up her burst.
Use Song of Celerity to step out of reach when Leona's Zenith Blade is on cooldown, or to run after she lands on you.
When Leona raises Eclipse, back away. Her blast only hurts enemies close by, so don't stand next to her.
Use Crescendo to stun Leona and her partner when they dive. Aim it so it hits everyone you can.
Stay out of Lulu's Glitterlance line and don't stand where she can slow you; Sona is easy to catch once slowed.
Keep Hymn of Valor going on Lulu and her partner whenever they step up to last-hit; it hits the two nearest enemies and builds Accelerando.
Lulu can polymorph you with Whimsy, so stay out of her range unless you are ready to be caught. Don't walk up to her without a reason.
Hold Crescendo for when Lulu or her carry is out of position. Her ally can be shielded, but the stun still lands on anyone it reaches.
Use Aria of Perseverance after trades to heal both you and your carry; it also builds Accelerando.
Use Hymn of Valor to poke Lux when she steps up to cast; it hits the nearest two enemies and prefers champions.
Stay out of Light Binding's line, and keep minions or allies from lining up in front of you. It roots the first two enemies it hits.
Once Lux has used Light Binding, step forward and trade with Hymn of Valor, because her next one is a while away.
Land your empowered attack with Song of Celerity as the last ability. It slows Lux, so she has trouble escaping your follow-up.
Do not stand in Lucent Singularity. It slows you, and the burst when it detonates slows you more.
Use Crescendo on Lux and her carry together when they commit. The stun makes them easy targets for your team.
Move to the side when you see Final Spark's red warning beam. Its range is very long, so do not rely on distance to stay safe.
Stay out of Twisted Advance range; if Maokai reaches you, you are rooted and your squishy body dies fast. Keep an ally between you and him.
Hit Maokai with Hymn of Valor only when you need the damage; every spell that hits him speeds up his Sap Magic healing.
Do not stand next to brush where Maokai could have tossed a sapling; Sapling Toss there hurts much more and slows you.
Use Song of Celerity to run out of a sapling's reach, or to catch up when Maokai has used his abilities.
Crescendo stuns everything in its line. Use it when Maokai commits, but not while Twisted Advance has him untargetable during the dash.
Hold Crescendo until Mel has used Rebuttal or you are sure it is off cooldown; she can destroy it as it travels.
Stay out of the long reach of Solar Snare; when she is rooted you are in trouble, so keep minions or allies between you and her.
Poke Mel with Hymn of Valor when she steps up; it hits the two nearest enemies and favors champions.
Back off when you take several hits from Mel; her stacked damage can finish you if you are low.
Poke with Hymn of Valor whenever Milio steps up to help a minion; it hits the nearest two enemies and prefers champions.
Stay out of a straight line with Milio. Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion or ally in front of you.
Crescendo stuns everything in a line, so use it when Milio and his carry are lined up. His Breath of Life cleanses it only if he casts it quickly enough.
Cast Aria of Perseverance in trades to heal and shield both you and your carry. Healing a hurt ally also builds your Accelerando.
Stay behind minions so Dark Binding hits them first. Walk wide of the lane's middle if Morgana's Dark Binding is ready.
Poke Morgana with Hymn of Valor while Dark Binding is on cooldown, then back off.
Wait for Morgana to spend Black Shield before you cast Crescendo; the shield will stop the stun.
Use Aria of Perseverance to heal through Tormented Shadow, and step out of the fire instead of standing in it.
Poke the enemy with Hymn of Valor whenever Nami steps up to help her carry; it hits the nearest two enemies and makes your next attacks hit harder.
Stay out of range of Aqua Prison's bubble; it lands after a short delay, so keep moving and step out of the circle.
Once Nami has used Aqua Prison, push forward and trade, because it has a long cooldown.
Back off from a champion with Tidecaller's Blessing on them. It wears off fast and makes them slow you.
Use Aria of Perseverance to heal and shield through Nami's pokes. Save Song of Celerity to escape or to chase after a trade.
Sidestep Tidal Wave, which travels slowly. Crescendo from you can stun the enemy team back when they are bunched up.
Stay behind your minions and keep away from Nautilus's Dredge Line; it stops on the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way blocks it.
Poke with Hymn of Valor when the enemy steps up for minions, since it hits the two nearest enemies and prefers champions.
Keep Crescendo ready for when Nautilus commits with Dredge Line; stunning him and his team lets your side win the fight.
Fight at range. Nautilus's Riptide only reaches a short distance, so stay outside it.
Use Song of Celerity for speed to get out of Riptide, and use the empowered attack to leave him slowed when he chases you.
Cast Aria of Perseverance as the shield and heal land on your lane partner before Nautilus's burst arrives.
Stay out of a straight line from Neeko; Tangle-Barbs roots you for longer once it has hit something, and Sona has no escape besides Song of Celerity.
Stand away from minions when Neeko has Tangle-Barbs ready, because a tangle that hits a minion first grows stronger.
Poke with Hymn of Valor when Neeko walks up to last-hit; it hits the two nearest enemies and prefers champions.
Save Crescendo for when Neeko or her team commits, and aim it so it catches more than one enemy.
Use Aria of Perseverance to shield your carry just before Neeko's burst lands, and keep it for when she commits.
Be wary of ally-looking champions or odd minions and wards near you; Neeko can disguise herself with Inherent Glamour and Pop Blossom can be readied in secret.
Keep your distance from Pantheon. Shield Vault stuns you the moment he lands, so stay out of its range and don't stand alone in front of your carry.
Use Hymn of Valor to poke him whenever he walks up to trade. It hits his two nearest enemies at long range and costs you little.
Don't fight in front of him while Aegis Assault is up. He takes no damage from that direction, so wait for it to end or hit him from the side.
Hold Crescendo for when he commits to a dive. If it stuns him, your team gets free damage on him.
When Pantheon is about to land Grand Starfall, you get several seconds of warning. Move out of the area and don't stay clumped with your team.
Cast Aria of Perseverance on your carry when Pantheon jumps in. Its shield and heal soak up his burst.
Stay well back from Poppy. Heroic Charge carries you into a wall and stuns you, so keep terrain away from your back.
Poke with Hymn of Valor from long range while Poppy has to walk up to you. Staying far away makes her much weaker.
Hold Crescendo until Poppy commits to a dive. Aim it so the stun also catches her allies.
Use Song of Celerity to move faster and keep your distance. Her Hammer Shock slows you, so stay out of its range.
Cast Aria of Perseverance to shield your ally as Poppy swings in, so her burst is absorbed.
Stay behind your minions and away from bushes. If Pyke hits you with Bone Skewer, you are pulled in and he can kill you quickly.
Pyke stuns with Phantom Undertow, so keep your distance. Use Song of Celerity to get away if he closes in.
Hit Pyke with Hymn of Valor whenever he is in range. It is a safe poke that also builds your Accelerando.
Chase Pyke off with Hymn of Valor before he can heal. He only regains health when you can't see him.
Watch for sharks under your feet. They mean Pyke is hidden nearby in Ghostwater Dive, so stay back and be ready to use Aria of Perseverance.
Hold Crescendo until Pyke commits to a pull or dash. It stuns him and anyone near him.
Keep your distance and use Hymn of Valor to poke Rakan whenever he walks up; it hits the nearest two enemies and favors champions.
Stay behind your ADC. Rakan's Grand Entrance dash lets him reach you fast and knock you up, and you have no escape.
Save Crescendo for when Rakan and his ally commit; it stuns everyone it hits in a line and stops The Quickness follow-up.
Cast Aria of Perseverance before Rakan's burst lands so the shield is up; it also heals you and your ally.
Use Song of Celerity to run away or reposition when Rakan engages; the speed lasts longer if you aren't hit.
Stay behind your carry and keep out of Rell's reach. Shattering Strike and Ferromancy: Crash Down both stun, and Sona has no escape once caught.
Poke Rell with Hymn of Valor while she is mounted and far away. It has long range and hits the nearest two enemies, champions first.
Keep Song of Celerity ready for when Rell mounts up and charges at you. The extra Move Speed helps you get away.
Use Crescendo on Rell and her team when they dive in. The stun stops her combo, and it only works if you stay out of reach until then.
Aria of Perseverance shield pops when Shattering Strike hits, since it destroys shields. Heal with it first and save the shield for other damage.
Stay out of Last Embrace range; it travels far and roots you after a short delay. Keep minions between you and Senna's aim line.
Hit Senna with Hymn of Valor whenever she walks up to attack. It reaches far and also builds your Accelerando.
Save Crescendo for when Senna or her partner is out of position. It stuns everyone it hits, so line up the enemy carry too.
Cast Aria of Perseverance when Senna pokes you. The heal and shield blunt her trades, and her long range makes trades frequent.
Use Song of Celerity to step out of a Last Embrace throw. It also helps you close in when Senna is out of position.
Use Hymn of Valor to poke when Seraphine steps up to last-hit; it hits the two nearest enemies and favors champions.
Stay out of Beat Drop's line. If you are slowed, it roots you, so keep moving and don't wander in a straight line toward her.
Save Crescendo for when Seraphine and her carry are bunched together; it stuns everyone in the line.
Use Song of Celerity to close the gap or escape, and keep your Power Chord attack ready for the slow it gives.
Use Aria of Perseverance after Seraphine's poke lands; it heals you and your ally.
Poke Shen with Hymn of Valor from range while he has no ally to protect; it hits the two nearest enemies, champions first.
Stay out of Shadow Dash range. If he taunts you, you can't walk away, so keep your own Aria of Perseverance ready for the heal.
Use Crescendo on Shen and the enemy carry together when they commit, so they are stunned and can't follow up.
Cast Song of Celerity before you auto him to get Power Chord's slow; it helps you step away from his dash.
Hit Soraka with Hymn of Valor whenever she steps up to heal. It also builds your Accelerando.
Stay out of Equinox. It silences you, so you can't cast, then roots you.
Land Crescendo on Soraka and your team when she is out of position. A long cooldown on Equinox means she can't easily zone you.
Use Song of Celerity to slip away from Starcall, or a Power Chord hit built from it to slow Soraka.
Use Hymn of Valor to poke Swain whenever he steps up for a minion; it hits the two nearest enemies and prefers champions.
Stay out of Nevermove's path and keep minions between you and him; if you get rooted, Swain can pull you in.
Use Song of Celerity to move out of Death's Hand range, since it hurts most up close.
Use Aria of Perseverance after you take Swain's poke to heal and shield your carry.
At level 6, Crescendo can stun Swain when he transforms, so he can't drain you. Aim it before he reaches you.
Stay out of Tongue Lash's line; it hits the first enemy in its path and leaves you slowed. Stand behind your own minions or your ally.
Use Hymn of Valor to poke him when he walks up, but stop once he has built stacks, because three stacks let him swallow you with Devour.
Keep Crescendo for when he commits with Abyssal Dive or Devour. The stun lets your team punish him.
Watch for the Abyssal Dive channel; he lands after a short wait. Step away from the marked spot or Flash out to avoid being knocked up.
Use Song of Celerity to get away or to line up your empowered attack. It will also slow him when your Power Chord is ready.
Poke Taric with Hymn of Valor whenever he steps up to the minions; he has no way to close the gap quickly except Dazzle.
Stay out of Dazzle's line and keep moving after Taric starts casting it; it bursts after a delay, so you can sidestep it.
Taric gets stunned by Crescendo for a long time; save it for when he commits to a fight so his team cannot follow up.
Use Aria of Perseverance to heal your carry after Taric trades, and use its shield when you expect his stun to land on you.
Use Song of Celerity to run away from Taric when he winds up an attack combo, then punish him once his empowered hits are gone.
Stay out of Death Sentence range and behind minions; the scythe stops at the first unit it hits, so a minion in the line protects you.
Watch Thresh's cast start and move sideways; Death Sentence has a long cast time, so a quick step can dodge it.
Poke him with Hymn of Valor whenever he walks up to hit a minion; it hits the two nearest enemies and favors champions.
Keep Song of Celerity ready to run away after he spends Death Sentence; the speed helps you get out of Flay range.
Use Crescendo on Thresh and his carry together when they commit; it stuns everything in a wide line.
Land your empowered attack with Aria of Perseverance on Thresh when he comes in to trade, so his damage drops.
Stay out of range of Vel'Koz's Tectonic Disruption and Plasma Fission; if you get stunned in lane, you will be hit by the rest of his combo.
Use Hymn of Valor to poke him whenever he steps up to hit minions; it hits the nearest two enemies and favors champions.
Save Crescendo for when Vel'Koz is out of position. Stunning him also interrupts his Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Cast Aria of Perseverance when his Void Rift is about to land. The shield and heal cover your partner's lane damage.
Walk sideways out of his Void Rift and keep moving; Song of Celerity gives you the speed to dodge his slow bolts.
Stay out of Shocking Orb's line. Keep a minion between you and Xerath, because the orb stops on the first enemy it hits.
Use Hymn of Valor to poke Xerath whenever he is in range. It hits the nearest two enemies and goes for champions first.
Cast Aria of Perseverance as Eye of Destruction or Arcanopulse is about to land. It heals you and an ally, and the shield absorbs some damage.
Charge in with Song of Celerity when Xerath is charging Arcanopulse. He moves slowly then, so you can close the distance.
Use Crescendo to stun Xerath when he is out of position, so your team can kill him. He has no escape.
Hit the enemy with Hymn of Valor whenever she is in range; each champion it damages builds your haste, and it picks champions over minions.
Use Crescendo when Yuumi is stuck on her carry and you can catch both of them, so they are stunned together.
Slow Yuumi's carry with an empowered attack from Song of Celerity, then follow up so your lane partner can trade.
Stay out of a long Prowling Projectile line. Step sideways, since it ends at the first unit it hits.
Cast Aria of Perseverance before a trade so your shield and heal cancel out her poke.
Stay out of Time Bomb's range, and walk away from a bomb stuck to you. Two bombs on one target make the first one stun.
Use Hymn of Valor on Zilean when he walks up. It hits the nearest two enemies and prefers champions.
Zilean is hard to kill when alone but fragile if your team focuses him. Commit with your lane partner and use Crescendo to stun him.
Wait for his Chronoshift to end before you finish a target he protected.
Hit Zyra and her plants with Hymn of Valor to poke; it hits the two nearest enemies, and it grows your Accelerando when it hits champions.
Stay out of Grasping Roots range, because Sona has little to escape once she is rooted. Walk wide of lane brush where Zyra may have seeds.
Use Song of Celerity to close the gap or to step out of the line of Grasping Roots.
Save Crescendo for when Zyra is rooted-in-place by nothing else: cast it when she commits forward, so she and her allies are stunned together.
Cast Aria of Perseverance as her spells land to shield and heal, then keep your Power Chord ready for a trade.
